summary: Painted median hatching on a main road; no stopping, nowhere to pull out.
reasons: Painted hatching, no room to stop

drivers.seclusion: Houses 15-17 m on the north-west side; fully exposed to traffic and the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb beside painted hatching at a junction; no pull-off clear of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy arterial with a junction immediately north.
drivers.convention: Three No Stopping Any Time signs; no cars park along this stretch.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; trees shade the roadside to the east.
